conclusion: Case B is the discriminator: Chromium reports SecurityError for a cross-origin DISABLED non-file input, i.e. its cross-origin check precedes its mutability check. The spec orders mutability first, so the spec would report InvalidStateError for the same call. Cases D/E show the file/color exemption removes the cross-origin branch, making the two orders indistinguishable for file inputs (hence the r80 cross-origin legs cannot discriminate, and cannot reach the SecurityError branch at all).
